packages.name: MacOS Microsoft Windows App
packages.releaseNotes:
In this release we made the following updates:
 
• Added support for launching Cloud PC and Azure Virtual Desktop resources from the Windows App web portal.
• Resolved an issue that caused the "Refresh All Resources" shortcut (Command + R) to sometimes fail after switching tabs.
• Added mitigations to prevent stuck Windows keys in the remote session.
• Resolved an issue where workspace refresh would get stuck when authentication or token acquisition fails.
• Fixed multi-monitor layout and scaling when Retina support is enabled (including mixed-resolution displays).
• Resolved issues with selection highlighting and keyboard focus in the account switcher.
• Improved WebAuthn redirection by resolving passkey registration issues with external security keys.
• Improved reconnection reliability and connection monitoring to help prevent premature session disconnections during network interruptions.
 
In addition, we've also made updates to strengthen security, performance and reliability, and to lay the groundwork for upcoming features.
 
This update requires macOS 15 and later. macOS 14 is no longer supported.
 
If you encounter any errors, you can contact us via Help > Submit Feedback.

packages.name: MacOS Microsoft To-Do
packages.releaseNotes: We fixed some bugs to improve the app experience.

packages.name: MacOS Microsoft CoPilot
packages.releaseNotes:
In this release:

New
• Ask the Money Assistant from wherever you are (iOS 26+). A suggested question now appears next to the assistant button on recurrings, credit cards, transactions, investment accounts, categories and more, like “Why the increase?” on a recurring that went up.
• A new What’s New section in Settings, starting with the Money Assistant (iOS 26+). A dot on the Settings gear tells you when there’s something new.
• Swipe to delete a conversation from your recent Money Assistant chats (iOS 26+).
• Easier than ever to get to Copilot on your Mac or the web from your iPhone app. Find the links in Settings, then email them to yourself or copy them.

Improved
• Consistent button styling throughout the app
• Easier-to-read Settings
• Smaller sheets scroll as one piece, with a subtle line under the header
• On iPad, transaction details now follow the same order as the web app
• A refined Money Assistant look in light and dark mode, with Genmoji and stickers in replies

Fixed
• Tapping your briefing notification opens your briefing
• Splitting a transaction saves reliably
• Investments and Accounts cards no longer flicker behind sheets
• Other bug fixes and performance improvements
